title: Your deploy crashed production? Roll back in 3 seconds
caption: Broke production? Here is how Kubernetes rolls back instantly. What is your go-to incident recovery trick?

scenes.vo: You just shipped a broken update straight to production. Users see errors everywhere, but Kubernetes has a built-in time machine.
scenes.heading: ROLLBACK

scenes.vo: Think of Deployments like browser history with an undo button. Every rollout creates a saved snapshot of your pods.
scenes.heading: SAVED HISTORY
scenes.line: Browser history with an instant undo button

scenes.vo: Revision one was perfectly healthy, but revision two crashed immediately. Your old ReplicaSet is actually still sitting there waiting silently.
scenes.heading: BEHIND THE SCENES

scenes.vo: Don't panic and rebuild docker images. One quick command undoes the deployment and restores healthy pods in seconds.
scenes.heading: INSTANT UNDO

scenes.vo: To check history, view rollout status. Inspect revisions, rollback safely, and restore uptime instantly. Follow for more practical Kubernetes in plain English!
scenes.heading: ROLLBACK
